name: Funding-fear agreement with macro-regime risk-on gate (composite under benign macro)
rationale: Conditions the funding+fear capitulation composite on a benign MACRO backdrop, testing whether contrarian crypto bounces work better when the broad risk regime is turning supportive. Arm a long when funding is soft (below ceiling) AND Fear&Greed is fearful AND the macro_regime composite has CROSSED UP through a risk-on threshold. macro_regime is a DRIFTING composite, so it is used ONLY via cross_up (the event operator) — never as a raw level — capturing the moment the macro regime flips supportive rather than a fitted static level (which would be a drifting-level trap). funding+fear supply the crypto-native positioning+sentiment agreement; the macro cross supplies the top-down permission. Funding ceiling straddles realized to bite (null carry). DISCONFIRMER: the funding+fear composite WITHOUT the macro gate is in this cohort — if the macro cross_up does not improve the deflated/holdout Sharpe (or merely shrinks trade count without raising hit-rate), it is a decorative regime filter and capitulation bounces do not actually need a benign macro backdrop. If the macro gate cuts trades below the Gate minimum, honest insufficient-evidence. Gate disposes.
catalyst: soft funding + fear while macro_regime crosses up into risk-on
